migration.title: Server migration (external drive)
migration.explanation: Captures a full server snapshot (Docker images/volumes, databases, Nginx config, applications, system packages, pwa-admin configuration) to the backup USB drive — use in case of a hardware change. Restore is done from the Restore screen, on the new server.
migration.noUsbConfigured: No USB drive configured as backup (see above).
migration.includeDuplicates: Include "-duplicate" containers (manual failover clones — usually unnecessary for migrating to a new server)

historyView.legend: Badges: "Local" = on this server (never encrypted) · "USB" and "Drive" = external copy · green closed padlock = encrypted · orange open padlock = not encrypted (readable) · grey ? = unknown. The latest successful backup of each source is highlighted.

keepOnlyLatestConfirm.title: Delete {{count}} older backup(s)?
keepOnlyLatestConfirm.description: Only the latest successful backup of "{{name}}" is kept. The other {{count}} are removed from the history and their local copies deleted; copies already on the USB drive or Google Drive are not touched.

hints.usbEncrypted: USB copy encrypted with the application key.
hints.usbPlain: Unencrypted USB copy: readable by anyone who plugs the drive in (unless the drive is LUKS-encrypted).
hints.driveEncrypted: Google Drive copy encrypted with the application key.
hints.drivePlain: Unencrypted Google Drive copy: readable by Google and anyone with access to the account.
hints.driveUnknown: Google Drive copy: encryption unknown (uploaded before this was tracked).
